summary: A congressman with nine children moved his family to Washington on a veteran's advice so he would see them more.
realLife: A California congressman with nine children took his whole family to Washington after advice from a former member, believing he would see them more that way. He said his wife was like a single mother while he was away.
gates: A seat is held at a capital away from home.
inGame: A move, a household and a seat held at a capital away from home can carry it; the new school follows the address.

turns.what: The family stays home and the official commutes.
turns.writesBack: Household stays; the official gets a second place.

turns.what: The family moves for the school year and returns in summer.
turns.pulledBy: A seat that sits only part of the year.
turns.writesBack: Two addresses on the household record.

turns.what: They move after a first term and a lost year with the children.
turns.writesBack: A move record; the children change school.
